schoolName: Université de N'Djaména — Faculté des Sciences de la Santé Humaine
reviewNotes: HOLD — current official pages establish an FSSH Medicine department at the Gardolé campus and identify Médecine Générale as a French-language doctorate programme. The faculty page lists medical specialities and a LaboRedes laboratory, and the university reports four campuses. However, current primary sources found do not disclose programme duration, tuition/mandatory fees, intake and application process, international eligibility, named teaching-hospital/clinical placement arrangements, accommodation/support terms or programme-level professional-recognition evidence. These gaps preclude a valuable, authoritative admissions page.
